answer: Quadratic voting with identity staking: each identity must lock 5000 POA for 28 days before voting. Vote weight = sqrt(credits spent). Attacker creating N fake identities pays N × 5000 POA locked capital, cost growing linearly with N. System verifies via on-chain stake registry and timestamp checks; slashing 25% if duplicate identities detected via zk-proof of unique personhood. The 67% consensus threshold ensures coordinated attacks require 5x honest capital. Words: summit, echo, opal.
